objective: Keep global connectivity notices limited to actual offline/limited internet and skip idle queue flushes
productionBaselineEvidence: verified: GitHub source main 9eecfd2a833d30f4168baeeccb26f021176b7b95 inspected 2026-11-17. Source main is not proof of the deployed production OTA; no release mutation authorized in this isolated fix.
chosenApproach: Keep offline/limited connectivity banner only; preflight replayable queues by account/handler/deadline before busy flags; retain terminal pending records without repeated writes.
selectionRationale: Stops false user-facing syncing and unnecessary idle work without changing network detection, writes, ad loading, authentication, retry limits, or native runtime.
alternativeApproaches: Merely hide the banner while continuing pointless periodic busy-state transitions (rejected because no-work activity persists).
Remove global offline sync completely (rejected because it would strand genuine saved actions).
preserveBehaviors: Offline and limited connection warnings retain pending counts and cached-data guidance.
Real queued writes replay when eligible with existing per-account guard, retry limits and batching.
Exhausted failures remain persisted and visible in feature-specific pending states.
Auth, AdMob, Wall/Connect feeds, media playback, sync cadence, native runtime and release controls remain untouched.
acceptanceChecks: Online and syncing statuses render no global banner, including Syncing 0 pending.
Offline and limited states still show the correct saved-data notice and pending count.
An empty, delayed, unhandled, exhausted or different-account queue does not start a busy state.
Eligible writes still replay with existing batch boundaries; queued data is never discarded.
Permanent failures do not cause repeated storage writes or subscriptions every periodic wake.
Focused Node tests and engineering gates pass; no production or staging OTA without separate immutable RC checks.

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: Global application connectivity banner and background replay eligibility have caused a visible false syncing indicator.
preservedBehaviors: Offline actions and cached content remain durable during weak signal and across app relaunches.
AdMob, Wall, Connect, auth, rewards and physical network reachability logic are not modified.
